definitions.MSD: ensemble mean-squared displacement of the interface (clone-boundary) centre position, lattice cells^2 (= cell diameters^2)
definitions.t_x: first frame at which the loaded ensemble MSD reaches 2x the neutral ensemble MSD at matched L_short (reproduces reduced_model_summary.msd_crossover.t_x_frames exactly: 16440/6440/6000 frames)
definitions.frames_to_divisions: divisions per site = frames * p_die, p_die = 0.02746 (reduced_model_summary.units)

variance_and_test.test: two-sample comparison of arm-mean MSD via the log of the ratio of arm means (delta method): Var[ln ratio] = CV^2/n_L + CV^2/n_N; equal arms; two-sided alpha=0.05, power 0.80

primary_CV_model.basis: boundary-normal displacement of one segment is a mean-zero Gaussian coordinate, so its squared displacement is chi^2_1: variance = 2*mean^2 (a modelling choice - the store logs ensemble-mean MSD curves only, not per-run trajectories)

empirical_cross_check.note: CV ~1.1-1.3 across 840 reduced-model loaded runs - broad, single-segment kinematics are as noisy as their mean; the primary sqrt(2) is slightly conservative relative to this

why_not_per_segment_log_test.reason: t-test on per-segment log squared-displacement (log chi^2_1, SD 2.22) tests the geometric mean, which the theory does not predict; use the ratio of arm means

cadence.requirement: resolve t_x with >=15 pre-crossover snapshots and continue to >=3 t_x

assumed_rates.mouse tail epidermis: 1 division per basal site per 3.5 days (ASSUMED)
assumed_rates.mouse esophagus: 1 division per basal site per 2 days (ASSUMED)

calendar_conversions_ILLUSTRATIVE_ASSUMP.feasibility_verdict: NOT feasible as literally posed: 3*t_x is ~5.1 years (tail) or ~2.9 years (esophagus) - the crossover is inaccessible within a mouse lifespan at the canonical load. The experiment must therefore (i) target a proliferating system with an effective divisions-per-site clock >= 20x faster (organoid / regenerating epithelium / rapidly renewing niche), or (ii) test the pre-crossover kinematic prediction (local MSD exponent of loaded vs neutral segments over 0.25-1 t_x: predicted log-slopes 1.56 vs 1.13, i.e. loaded segments diffuse anomalously fast BEFORE their MSD separates in amplitude), which needs only ~1 t_x of imaging (0.9-1.7 yr in these tissues, still long) or a scaled-down excursion amplitude readout (7 vs 5 cell diameters rms at 1 t_x).

numbered_experimental_spec.system: a two-dimensional stratified/columnar epithelium in which independent neutral clone boundaries and boundaries between a fitter (biased-fate / driver) clone and its neutral neighbour can BOTH be imaged longitudinally; the falsification requires the same tissue and imaging pipeline for both arms. Mouse tail epidermis or esophagus give the strongest genetic tools but, on the illustrative clock (1 division/site per 3.5 or 2 days), place t_x = 177 divisions/site at ~1.7 yr / ~1.0 yr - see feasibility_verdict.
numbered_experimental_spec.sourced_numbers: t_x = 176.8 divisions/site (6440 frames x p_die 0.02746, reduced_model_summary.msd_crossover)

numbered_experimental_spec.primary_observable: MSD(t) of the local boundary (interface) centre position, in cell diameters^2, for n independently tracked, non-adjacent boundary segments per arm (segment = one clonal interface followed over time; segments from the same clone edge separated by >= 3x the correlation length of the front, otherwise counted as one)
numbered_experimental_spec.sourced_numbers: rms boundary excursion predicted 6.9 cell diameters (loaded) vs 4.9 (neutral) at t_x; 14.3 vs 8.2 at 2 t_x; 22.4 vs 10.2 at 3 t_x (192x32 canonical curves)

numbered_experimental_spec.sample_size: n = 66 independent boundary segments per arm (132 total) to detect the predicted ratio-2 separation with 80% power at two-sided alpha = 0.05; n = 27 per arm (54 total) if the design waits for the ratio-3 separation predicted by 3 t_x (26/arm gives exactly 80%). Inflate for 25% tracking dropout: 88 and 36 per arm.
numbered_experimental_spec.sourced_numbers: delta-method test on ln(ratio of arm-mean MSD) with per-segment CV = sqrt(2) (Gaussian-coordinate assumption; empirical run-to-run CV of the end-of-run width diagnostic across 840 reduced-model runs is 1.19, so sqrt(2) is conservative). z = 1.960 + 0.842.

numbered_experimental_spec.cadence: one snapshot every ~10 divisions per site (>= 15 snapshots before t_x, 53 by 3 t_x); in calendar terms 5 weeks (tail, assumed) or 3 weeks (esophagus, assumed). A coarser 20-division cadence still resolves t_x with 9 pre-crossover snapshots.

numbered_experimental_spec.duration: >= 2 t_x = 354 divisions per site for the ratio-2 endpoint (ratio predicted 3.05 there, so ratio 2 is conservative); 3 t_x = 530 divisions per site for the ratio-3 endpoint (ratio predicted 4.84). Illustrative calendar: 2 t_x = 1,238 d (~3.4 yr, tail) / 707 d (~1.9 yr, esophagus); 3 t_x = 1,857 d / 1,061 d. Since t_x is not directly observable in the neutral arm alone, define the analysis window a priori in divisions/site from an independently measured tissue division rate.
numbered_experimental_spec.sourced_numbers: MSD ratios at 2 t_x and 3 t_x from the canonical curve pair (loaded 204.3 vs neutral 67.0 cells^2; 503.4 vs 104.0)

numbered_experimental_spec.decision_rule: compute R = mean MSD(loaded segments) / mean MSD(neutral segments) at the pre-registered time (in divisions per site) with a delta-method 95% CI on ln R. Prediction for the canonical 192x32, mud=0.1 condition: R = 3.0 at 2 t_x and R = 4.8 at 3 t_x. The simulated geometries/drives spread widely (1.72-5.16 at 2 t_x across 7 conditions; 2.19-9.39 at 3 t_x across 7), so the corroboration band must be pre-registered from the reduced-model curve matched to the tissue's geometry and load, not treated as universal. The theory is corroborated if the CI on R excludes 1 and covers the matched-condition prediction.

numbered_experimental_spec.falsifying_outcome: R statistically indistinguishable from 1 (95% CI of ln R containing 0) at >= 2 t_x with the pre-registered n - i.e., boundaries adjacent to fitter clones do not diffuse faster than neutral boundaries once the crossover time has elapsed. A ratio R < 2 at 2 t_x with a CI excluding 3 also refutes the quantitative prediction. Note the theory itself predicts NO separation before ~0.5 t_x (R = 0.97-1.28 at 0.25-0.5 t_x), so an early null is not falsifying: the pre-registered window must be past t_x.
numbered_experimental_spec.sourced_numbers: R at 0.25 t_x = 0.97, at 0.5 t_x = 1.28 (canonical curves)

numbered_experimental_spec.control_and_confound: segment independence is the load-bearing assumption of the sample-size calculation (adjacent stretches of one front are correlated and count once); the neutral arm must be imaged with identical cadence and depth, because MSD estimates are cadence-dependent at short times (local log-slopes 1.1-1.6, i.e. neither arm is purely diffusive over the design window).

not_established: The calendar durations are illustrative: the division-rate constants are assumptions supplied for scale, not measurements in these files; the per-segment variance is a Gaussian-coordinate model (the store holds ensemble-mean MSD only); segment independence and the correlation length of a real clonal front are unmeasured. On the illustrative clocks the crossover lies beyond a mouse lifespan, so the specification as posed (2-3 t_x) requires a faster-cycling system - this is a genuine constraint the manuscript must state, not a solvable design detail.
